{'code': "from qgis.PyQt.QtWidgets import QAction, QToolBar
mw = iface.mainWindow()
acts = [(x.objectName(), x.text(), x.isCheckable(), x.isChecked()) for x in mw.findChildren(QAction) if 'qfieldsync' in x.objectName().lower() or 'QFieldSync' in x.text()]
tbars = [(t.objectName(), t.windowTitle(), t.isVisible()) for t in mw.findChildren(QToolBar) if 'qfield' in (t.objectName() + t.windowTitle()).lower()]
result = {'actions': acts, 'toolbars': tbars}"}

{'code': "from qgis.PyQt.QtWidgets import QAction, QToolBar
mw = iface.mainWindow()
a = [x for x in mw.findChildren(QAction) if x.text() == 'QFieldSync\u30c4\u30fc\u30eb\u30d0\u30fc'][0]
t = [x for x in mw.findChildren(QToolBar) if x.objectName() == 'QFieldSync Toolbar'][0]
a.trigger()
result = {'checked': a.isChecked(), 'visible': t.isVisible()}"}
